checks.name: phase_g_files_exist
command: test -f Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h && test -f Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp && test -f Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h && test -f Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.h && test -f Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.cpp && test -f Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h && test -f Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp && test -f tests/ResonanceTests.cpp

checks.name: cmake_lists_lists_phase_g_sources
command: rg -q "AnalysisFifo\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "SpectralAnalysisEngine\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ResonanceDetector\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ResonanceSuppressor\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt && rg -q "ResonanceTests\.cpp" CMakeLists.txt

checks.name: spectral_engine_stft_and_fifo_present
command: rg -q "Hann|hann|FFT|fft|STFT|stft" Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp && rg -q "AbstractFifo|Fifo|FIFO|pushAudio|hop" Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.h Source/Analysis/AnalysisFifo.cpp && rg -q "skip|overload|enabled|Thread|TimeSlice" Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.cpp

checks.name: resonance_detector_persistence_and_harmonic_rejection
command: rg -q "persist|Persist|lambda|excess|baseline" Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.h Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.cpp && rg -q "f0|harmonic|PitchDetector|confidence|candidate|Candidate" Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.h Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.cpp

checks.name: resonance_suppressor_six_slots_and_scan
command: rg -q "slot|Slot|notch|Notch" Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp && rg -q "6|kNumSlots|numSlots|six" Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp && rg -q "[Ss]can|applyCandidate|audition|removed" Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.h Source/DSP/ResonanceSuppressor.cpp Source/PluginProcessor.h Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
